    Lemma B.1: top paths of Π(D_n) #

    lem:d-top-paths (characteristic-two-mesh-calculations.tex): "Let Π(D_n) be the preprojective algebra of type D_n, and put N = n − 2. Let ν be the identity if N is even and the short-arm interchange if N is odd. At every vertex x, there is a nonzero path of degree 2N from x to ν x. This holds over every field."

    The proof computes the recurrence matrices U_d of eq:preprojective-lower-bound through the line formula: on the line −N, …, N, (V_d)_{ij} = 1 exactly when |i − j| ≤ d ≤ 2N − |i + j| and d ≡ i − j (mod 2), and for D_n (U_d)_{rt} = (V_d)_{r,t} + (V_d)_{r,−t}, (U_d)_{ar} = (U_d)_{br} = (V_d)_{0,r}, with the short-leaf block ½[[1 + (−1)^q, 1 − (−1)^q], [1 − (−1)^q, 1 + (−1)^q]] in degree d = 2q and zero in odd degree. We check that this closed form satisfies the recurrence for d ≤ 2N (F_rec), so it equals U_d (U_eq_F); it is nonnegative, and U_{2N} is the permutation matrix of ν: the identity for N even (d_return, the case used in Appendix B) and the short-arm interchange nu for N odd (d_return_odd); both together are dTopPaths.

    Labels: the star has short arms a, b with one vertex each and the long arm c; the spine vertex at depth j of the long arm has line position j + 1 and the centre has position 1.
